title: senna leiophylla
intro: Senna leiophylla, commonly known as the Himalayan senna, is a plant species belonging to the Fabaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine to treat various health conditions, with reported health benefits including the treatment of constipation, diarrhea, and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Senna leiophylla are attributed to its laxative and anti-inflammatory properties, which are thought to be due to the presence of bioactive constituents such as anthraquinones and flavonoids. The bioactive constituents of Senna leiophylla, particularly the anthraquinones, are responsible for its medicinal properties, including its ability to stimulate bowel movements and reduce inflammation.
